subject: Pen test report & remediation timeline needed for procurement gate (Arcadia Therapeutics)
messages:
From: Sophia Lawrence <sophia.lawrence@arcadia-thera.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@arcadia-thera.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Pen test report request for procurement gate (MAP deadline 2026-07-29)

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Arcadia is finalizing our vendor risk review for this integration and procurement requires the most recent penetration test report and a remediation status update tied to open findings. Our deadline to clear the MAP gate is 2026-07-29 to keep the timeline for the POC contract.

Can you provide: 1) a redacted pen test executive summary we can share with procurement; 2) a remediation tracker with ETA for open findings and point owners; and 3) confirmation whether the full report can be shared to our security team under NDA (we can provide a standard vendor NDA).

If we can get the summary and tracker by EOD 2026-07-23 that would be ideal for our internal review. Please let me know next steps and any blockers.

Best,
Sophia Lawrence
Technical Procurement
Arcadia Therapeutics
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sophia Lawrence <sophia.lawrence@arcadia-thera.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report request for procurement gate (MAP deadline 2026-07-29)

Hi Sophia —

Appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. Short answer: yes, we can support this gate. Options to move quickly:

- We can provide a redacted executive summary that removes customer-identifying test payloads and exploit PoCs (attachment: pen_test_execsum_redacted.pdf).
- We will include a remediation tracker with assigned owners and target close dates (attachment: remediation_tracker_v1.xlsx).
- The vendor that performed the assessment allows sharing of the full report to named third parties provided a signed NDA or Data Processing Addendum is in place; we can route that via Legal.

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach the redacted exec summary and tracker by EOD today.
2) Marissa (legal) will confirm the wording required for the NDA so you can sign; once in place we can deliver the full report to the named security contacts.
3) We’ll call out high/medium/low findings and give a remediation ETA for each category — I expect to have preliminary dates in the tracker version I send.

If Arcadia needs anything more formal (attestation letter, SOC 2 mapping), flag it and I’ll add to the deliverable list.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference

To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report request for procurement gate (MAP deadline 2026-07-29)

Vivek — I’ll start the NDA template and push to Arcadia’s procurement. Two notes:

- We need to ensure any redactions preserve the finding severity and remediation steps; procurement usually accepts an exec summary + remediation tracker.
- Rishi, can you confirm we’re comfortable sharing the CVE identifiers and remediation timelines in the tracker (they ask for root cause + mitigation ETA)?

I’ll circulate the DocuSign link once I have the Arcadia contact populated.

Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report request for procurement gate (MAP deadline 2026-07-29)

Marissa / Vivek — quick update from the security team and the vendor: we can share CVE IDs, severity, affected component, and remediation status in the tracker. The vendor requires removal of exploit code, payload samples, and internal IPs from any shareable PDF.

Plan:
- I’ll produce a sanitized executive summary and a tracker indicating owner and ETA for each open finding.
- High severity items: target closure in 6–10 business days depending on customer-impact testing windows.
- Medium: 10–20 business days.
- Low: documented and scheduled in the next maintenance cycle.

I’ll attach the sanitized materials to the next message; Marissa, please share the NDA when ready so we can offer the full report to the named Arcadia contacts.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Applied Security
From: Michael Chen <michael.chen@arcadia-thera.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophia Lawrence <sophia.lawrence@arcadia-thera.com>
Date: 2026-07-22T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test report request for procurement gate (MAP deadline 2026-07-29)

Vivek / Rishi / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Arcadia is fine with the redacted exec summary plus remediation tracker for the procurement review. Two asks to close the gate:

1) Can you provide a short attestation (1 paragraph) confirming the report is the latest assessment and that the tracker reflects all open findings as of this date?
2) Please include expected closure dates by severity in the tracker and identify the technical owner we can follow up with.

If we receive the above and the tracker by EOD 2026-07-23, we can clear the MAP and proceed to finalize SOW signatures the following week.

Regards,
Michael Chen
Senior Manager, Vendor Security
Arcadia Therapeutics

Michael —

Attestation (one-paragraph):
Redwood Inference confirms the attached executive summary is a redacted excerpt from the most recent independent penetration test conducted on 2026-06-28. The remediation tracker reflects all open findings identified in that assessment as of 2026-07-23 and lists the current owner and target remediation dates.

High severity: target remediation 2026-08-06 (subject to verification testing).
Medium severity: rolling remediation between 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-23.
Low severity: scheduled for the August maintenance window and tracked to completion.

We will follow up with your security lead to schedule any verification testing and will provide the full report to named Arcadia personnel once the NDA is executed. HubSpot link to the deal is included.

Next: Marissa — please send DocuSign NDA to sophia.lawrence@arcadia-thera.com.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Revenue, Redwood Inference
